newsitem.title: USA: Class action filed vs some AMRE directors.
newsitem.headline: Class action filed vs some AMRE directors.

text.p: Plaintiffs' attorneys said Friday they had filed a class action petition against 13 current or former directors of Amre Inc accusing them of defrauding certain investors.

A statement from the law firms of Wolf Popper LLP and Puls & Chambers LLP said the complaint alleges the defendants defrauded buyers of AMRE stock by distributing false information about AMRE's financial results and prospects.

"This scheme is alleged to have artificially inflated the price of Amre common stock and enabled some defendants to sell off virtually all of their personal holdings of Amre stock during the class period for proceeds in excess of $10 million," the statement said.
The suit covers buyers of the company's stock between August 1, 1996, and January 17, 1997.
The company, which filed for Chapter 11 protection in January, did not answer calls to its office.
